why: Check 4 in the verifier brief does the first must_not item. It runs `curl ... https://o.github.io/greet-cli/` and gives PASS or FAIL from what the live page shows right now: "PASS: the output contains `HTTP 200` and at least one line containing `--shout`. FAIL: the status is not 200...". It also tells the verifier to "Report the actual result as FAIL". So line 4 gets a verdict from today's live page, even though the brief admits the line can only hold after merge and deploy. The brief does avoid the second item: it says "Do not mark it PASS based on docs/index.md alone", so there is no silent PASS. The builder brief is fine, since it only says to mention in the PR that this line can only be confirmed after merge. Because Check 4 breaks the first item, the criterion fails.
